items.资讯标题: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
items.desc: Standard demographic fairness benchmarks often test whether a model selects the same candidate in otherwise identical scenarios after the candidates' demographic identities are swapped. To see whether the evaluation setup explained the discrepancy between FairStress and BBQ, we took the same BBQ questions and model weights and tested five configurations that varied the chat template, question wording, and use of fixed-option probability scoring or answer generation. Open, rigorous evaluation is central to our broader work at Ai2, and we hope FairStress gives the community another useful tool for understanding where models fall short and how to improve them.

items.资讯标题: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
items.desc: A fair objection is that learned guidelines might have less to add to an agent using a frontier model: maybe they only patch the gaps of a weaker model. On the base split the agent with learned guidelines reaches Pass^4 = 67.5%, ahead of every frontier model and ahead of RAFT-30B-A3B (61.4%), a model fine-tuned on synthetic τ²-bench retail data. Same message in both domains: learning guidelines around the model works across different base models — bringing an agent using an older, non-reasoning model into frontier company on retail, and taking an agent using a frontier model to the top on airline.
